title: Bone Tool Diversity During the Stone Age: More Insights into the Human Story
version: Online 21 November 2025, issue 34 pp. 151–205 in 2026; complete open-access HTML
lineage: Comparative scholarly review. A poorly preserved Olduvai specimen has been proposed as much older but its interpretation is disputed; review dates do not establish origins or continuity.

passages.note: Bone projectile-point section: poorly preserved possible Olduvai barbs; approximately 90 ka Katanda points; earlier unbarbed bone points at El Mnasara.
